# Food reference matrix v1 — 2026-11-04

51 offline cases, 23 distinct source identities: 12 USDA FNDDS records, eight historical CNF-derived household portions and three Canadian manufacturer web records. Each source has its own URL, basis grams, serving, source version and literal reported values. Each case freezes inputs, expected amounts and coverage independently of Bloom's runtime calculator. The source facts are engineering references, not independently reviewed nutritional advice.

- USDA: existing read-only FNDDS2021–2023 catalogue, pinned SHA-256 in the fixture and original archive receipt in `server/data/fndds-manifest.json`. Individual FDC links identify every selected record. Raw/cooked, restaurant preparation, added oil/butter and explicit mass remain distinct. This freeze does not independently validate the original catalogue transformation.
- Historical CNF: [Health Canada's NVSCF2008 tables](https://www.canada.ca/en/health-canada/services/food-nutrition/healthy-eating/nutrient-data/nutrient-value-some-common-foods-2008.html), derived from CNF2007b. The selected row's household portion supplies its gram and nutrient basis. Trace and N/A remain literal strings in `reported` and the private source note; they cannot become numeric zero. These are **not CNF2026 fixtures**. [Current Health Canada description](https://www.canada.ca/en/health-canada/services/food-nutrition/healthy-eating/nutrient-data/canadian-nutrient-file-about-us.html) distinguishes the2026 download from the interim2015 online application. Current CNF2026 evaluation/source integration remains separate.
- Canadian manufacturer web facts, opened2026-11-04: [KITKAT single45g](https://www.madewithnestle.ca/kit-kat/4-finger-wafer-bar.html), [KIT KAT four-pack](https://www.madewithnestle.ca/kit-kat/kit-kat-4-x-45-g.html), [Michelina's Original Macaroni & Cheese255g](https://www.michelinas.ca/en/products/original/macaroni-cheese). The two chocolate pages report fibre1g/sugar23g and fibre0g/sugar22g respectively. They are separate identities, not silently merged as one formulation. The pasta page supplies only selected nutrients in its text table; fibre/sugar stay unknown here. No barcode, publication/reformulation date, laboratory certainty or agreement with the user's physical package is inferred.

The private-reference cases enter the **existing manual-label path**, using user-entered source context and frozen label snapshots. They do not create a CNF adapter, scrape a live catalogue, impersonate USDA Branded records, activate a new provider or grant redistribution/licensing approval. No production catalogue is expanded by this fixture. Real Canadian package/live lookup/physical-device acceptance remains open.

Expected answers were frozen using base-10 Decimal multiplication/summation with half-up two-decimal rounding and Bloom's existing rule retaining positive amounts smaller than the display precision. The test never calls Bloom's rounding helper to generate its expected answers. Cases include original and half portions, mixed sources, unknown/trace, true zero, fractional recipes, source revision differences and exact source IDs. `fractional-mixed-source-round-once` expects5.28g fat; premature subtotal rounding can produce5.29g. The initial mixed-source case reproduced9.28g versus a9.29g reference before the binary tie/round-once fix.

`tests/food-golden.test.ts` passes each case through the actual canonical analysis and manual-product service; verifies source snapshots, coverage and exact expected amounts; serializes/reloads the meal DTO; checks daily summary, recorded-food Progress and historical totals. Fault cases deliberately multiply the portion tenfold and substitute the other chocolate record: both must fail the reference assertion. A foreign owner cannot resolve the private reference. These are deterministic engine/projection checks; real encrypted save/retry/edit/delete and UI/owner flows are covered by existing meal tests and browser journeys, not claimed from this fixture alone.

New analyses carry `nutritionCalculationVersion: 2026-11-04`. Existing saved nutrition/source snapshots are not rewritten. A review made with an older calculation can require a fresh review before confirmation. No schema migration or provider configuration changes.

Run: `node --import tsx --test tests/food-golden.test.ts tests/nutrition-history.test.ts tests/nutrition-display.test.ts`.
